label: VSP or Arborist (not routed)
summary: A course without `routing` in its vegetation-rules.json (Vreta) decides while drawing which planted trees stay in the course's own VSP and which Arborist draws, set in its arborist-species.json; Unity then trims the ones Arborist took over.
steps: Starts from the trees Unity planted (golfmap.trees.dump): position, rotation, scale and prefab of each.
Prefabs whose name contains a `vsp` entry stay in the course's own VSP; every other tree becomes an Arborist item, mapped by `trees` (prefab -> Arborist model, with an optional look and keep share).

Far rule: a tree both more than outsideOob metres outside the course boundary (the GKD's pOOB) and more than fromPlay metres from play (rough, semi, fairway, green, tee, bunker) is scenery: billboard only. Every tree inside the boundary is a full model.
outerKeep thins the billboard-only trees outside the boundary, by distance band: [up to metres, share kept]; deterministic by position.
With `forstRing` (renamed forstRing_off = off) the VSP trees further than playM from play become full Arborist models of the replacement species.
The VSP trees Arborist now draws are written to <slug>-vsp-far.json: Unity trims them (golfmap.vsp.trees.trim).

rules.text: Trees whose prefab name contains one of these stay in the course's own VSP.
The Arborist model (and look, keep share) for each other prefab.
The ring rule: VSP trees beyond playM from play become Arborist models (off when missing).
Billboard only beyond this outside the course boundary (pOOB) ...
